fy2025.notes: Total is the sum of disclosed FY2025 capex guides from the four largest US hyperscalers. fy2026.notes: Total is the sum of the 2026 capex guides the four largest US hyperscalers stated in their Q3 2026 earnings releases and calls, with Alphabet and Meta at the midpoints of their ranges. The definitions differ: Microsoft and Meta count finance leases, Alphabet and Amazon report cash purchases of property and equipment, and Microsoft's figure is a calendar-year estimate because its fiscal year ends in June. Treat the total as directional. Alphabet said it expects capex to increase significantly in 2027; Meta said it is still developing its 2027 plans. Every figure was read from the cited primary document on 2026-10-30.
